# VLC Skin Studio {{VERSION}}

Read, edit, validate, render and package VLC skins2 themes. A dockable desktop
UI on FlatLaf, a terminal UI, a CLI and an MCP server for AI clients share one
document model. Unknown attributes and elements are preserved on save, so a
theme from any VLC version opens and writes back without losing data. Requires
Java 25.

## Install

1. Download `vlc-skin-studio.jar` and `SHA256SUMS` from the assets below.
2. Check the download: `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS`.
3. Run the desktop UI: `java -jar vlc-skin-studio.jar`. For the CLI, the
   terminal UI or the MCP server, run `java -jar vlc-skin-studio.jar --help`.

Java 25 is required. VLC is only needed for the "Test skin in VLC" menu item.

## Documentation

The controls, the CLI and MCP reference and the honest known limits live in the
